package handler

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	turncomp "GENRE_MODULE/game/components/turn"
	playerentity "GENRE_MODULE/game/entities/player"
	sender "GENRE_MODULE/game/handler/syncsender"
	rules "GENRE_MODULE/game/modules/scenariorules"
	bots "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
)

// 回合 PvP 的夹具差异（genre-common/gameplay_test.go.txt 的约定）：命令目标是 room 模块的 Room（genre-common/room_test.go.txt），
// 回合与期限来自 turn，每回合 30 秒；总回合数取 turn 的上限，对局靠生命分胜负。
const (
	scenarioTurnMillis int64 = 30000
	scenarioMaxTurns   int64 = 10000
)

// registerScenario：本玩法的 handler 是全局注册；room / turn 与 Room 定时器的 handler 归属 game 服务，按引擎实例注册。
func registerScenario(engine *nest.NestMgr) error {
	RegisterScenarioNestHandlers()
	for _, register := range []func(*nest.NestMgr) error{RegisterRoomJoinNestHandlersOn, RegisterRoomReconnectNestHandlersOn, RegisterRoomDisconnectNestHandlersOn, RegisterTurnStartNestHandlersOn, RegisterTurnViewNestHandlersOn, RegisterTickRoomTimerGenNestHandlersOn} {
		if err := register(engine); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// open：宿主开房 + 名单（一笔事务）→ 两人 RoomJoin 入座 → 房主 TurnStart 开局（登记第一个回合期限）。
func (e *scenarioEnv) open(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := sender.NewScenarioSender(e.engine).Sync_ScenarioOpen(ctx, e.target.ID(), [2]int64{e.players[0].ID(), e.players[1].ID()}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	e.seat(t)
	host := e.players[0].ID()
	if _, err := sender.NewTurnStartSender(e.engine).Sync_TurnStart(ctx, e.target.ID(), host, e.epochs[host], e.conns[host], scenarioTurnMillis, scenarioMaxTurns); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

type pvpFacts struct {
	match    string
	running  bool
	round    int64
	actor    int64
	deadline int64
}

// state 把 RoomDao.PvpState 与 turn 的回合事实拼成 rules.State（在 Room 锁内一次读出）。
func (e *scenarioEnv) state(t *testing.T) rules.State {
	t.Helper()
	facts := scenarioRead(t, e, e.target, func() pvpFacts {
		dao := e.room().Dao()
		turn := dao.GetTurn()
		actor := int64(0)
		if p, ok := turn.GetPlayers(int(turn.GetActive())); ok {
			actor = p.GetPlayerID()
		}
		return pvpFacts{dao.GetPvpState(), turn.GetStatus() == turncomp.TurnRunning, turn.GetRound(), actor, turn.GetDeadline()}
	})
	match, err := rules.Decode(facts.match)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return match.State(facts.running, facts.round, facts.actor, facts.deadline)
}

func (e *scenarioEnv) sendAs(p *playerentity.Player, c rules.Command) (rules.Result, error) {
	return sender.NewScenarioSender(e.engine).MultiSync_ScenarioCommand(context.Background(), e.target.ID(), p.ID(), e.epochs[p.ID()], e.conn(p), c)
}

// closeScenario 撤掉 Room 定时器在全局驱动里的登记（实体不再用）。
func (e *scenarioEnv) closeScenario() {
	e.room().TimerComp().OnDestroy(entity.DestroyReasonMemoryUnload)
}

// scenarioSmoke：接管席位 → 第一拍攻击 → 同连接重发 → 换连接再接管 → 重发；都只提交一次（命中奖励 1）。
func scenarioSmoke(t *testing.T, f *scenarioFixture) []bots.Step {
	t.Helper()
	c := f.command(t, 0, "attack")
	attack := bots.Step{Request: pb.ScenarioCommandRequest{RoomID: f.roomKey(), Seq: c.Seq, Revision: c.Revision, Kind: c.Kind}, Revision: 1, Reward: rules.HitReward}
	return []bots.Step{f.takeover(t, 0), attack, attack, f.retake(), attack}
}
